world_read.summary: A glossy rubber-hose cartoon pile of monsters, skulls, goo creatures, boxes and fanged puddle-mouths fills the lower half of a flat cobalt-blue field. At center, a pink blob character raises both pink hands to lift a gold-rimmed oval mirror into the open blue sky. The mirror holds a collage face of eyes, lips, a checkerboard, a star and a sleeping profile.
